reviews.title: What??
reviews.text: All it did when I opened it was to show a constant picture ad of Tik Tok with a link at bottom to download it. Tried 3 separate times, did not work. Horrible. Plus it’s very misleading to call the app Gstreet, the G makes it sound like GOOGLE MAPS and it’s NOT. The good reviews, as always, appear totally fake. Apple? Hello? Can you please vet your apps a little better before putting trash on your site? Just asking. Deleted.
